# Data Availability Statement {.unnumbered}

comdynamite is written in R [@rcoreteam2026r] and distributed under the MIT license. It imports only ape [@paradis2019ape] and base packages; every other dependency is optional. The package exports 121 functions, covered by 548 unit-test blocks that run on macOS, Windows and Linux at every change. The source code is at <https://github.com/diogoprov/comdynamite>, binaries are built by r-universe (`install.packages("comdynamite", repos = c("https://diogoprov.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))`), and the documentation, articles and function reference, including the replications and the nesting map, are at <https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/>. Each release is archived on Zenodo under the concept DOI <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23993533> [@Provete_2026]; this article describes version 0.9.0 (<https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24341231>). The scripts that produced every result and figure are in the `data-raw/` and `paper/` folders of the repository.
